scenario: Concurrent duplicate requests with same key/hash and same key/different hash

scenario: Crash after DB commit before publish and crash after publish before mark

scenario: Concurrent duplicate message delivery to same consumer

scenario: Stable sequence, same timestamps, cursor replay, expired cursor recovery

scenario: Per-step recovery across quiz shell/category/question/slot with Local Plugin lookup and without lookup

scenario: Composite Moodle publish at maximum quiz size: outer tool-call budget, external-step envelope, per-step timeout and async durable acknowledgement
required_evidence: A maximum-size approved QuizSpec is converted to a bounded step plan <=256; the create command returns durable acceptance within 15s; each step is tracked with an immutable key and 30s timeout; writes serialize per connection; task deadline stops further dispatch and reconciles UNKNOWN steps.
